subtitle: Cornell notes your AI can turn into a quiz.
about: A note with questions beside your lecture notes, short summaries and a checklist of missed questions. Give your AI notes to arrange and quiz you on, or cover the answers and test yourself.

ask.prompt: Set up the Cornell notes template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Make Cornell notes
slides.you: Here are my notes from today's lecture on supply and demand.
slides.ai: Made Cornell notes: a cue beside each note, and a short summary.
slides.alt: Cornell notes filled in, in Pinto Notes on a Mac

slides.label: Get quizzed
slides.you: Quiz me on supply and demand.
slides.ai: You missed what shifts the demand curve, so it's under Cues to revisit.
slides.alt: Cues to revisit, in Cornell notes

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.note: Or tick and edit it yourself.
slides.alt: Cornell notes as it starts, ready to fill in
